spaces.label: Multi-step public service journey
goodFit: A journey has a start, finish and useful task order across services.
poorFit: Users only read guidance, or choices have no useful order.
superficialDoNotBorrow: GOV.UK visual styling, departmental names and exact step wording

spaces.label: Revision-aware editorial record
goodFit: Content changes matter for editorial accountability or recovery.
poorFit: A transient draft has no need for retained public revision history.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Wiki page chrome, minor-edit letter and contributor-name layout

spaces.label: Exception-led production coordination
goodFit: Work has detectable defects and an accountable responder can intervene.
poorFit: Stopping work would create greater harm, or no one can assess the signal.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Factory rope, andon board appearance and Toyota process terminology

spaces.label: Pause-and-inspect diagnostic instrument
goodFit: A process can be paused safely and state at that point is informative.
poorFit: Real-time or safety-critical action cannot tolerate a pause.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Red breakpoint icon, keyboard shortcuts and editor panel layout

spaces.label: Visible production dependency simulation
goodFit: Learning or planning benefits from experimenting with resource flow.
poorFit: The real domain has constraints the simulation cannot represent honestly.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Pixel art, game recipes, item names and progression rewards

spaces.label: Bounded transaction handoff
goodFit: A payment flow has a clear order and requires specialized collection.
poorFit: There is no payment transaction or handoff to a payment provider.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Stripe branding, exact form styling and upsell presentation

spaces.label: Topic-anchored conversation
goodFit: Several topics progress concurrently and replies need local context.
poorFit: An urgent update must reliably reach everyone in the channel.
superficialDoNotBorrow: Slack icons, emoji reactions and channel color treatment

spaces.label: Typed conceptual navigation
goodFit: People search or browse a concept scheme with different relation types.
poorFit: The information has no defensible hierarchy or associative taxonomy.
superficialDoNotBorrow: SKOS namespace syntax, example letters and diagram styling
